faq.subtitle: Answers to frequently asked questions about Authentic Guards technology.

items.q: What is the AuthenticGuards 5-layer security system?
items.a: Our layered security system consists of: (1) Server Security — multi-layer protection to ISO/IEC 27000:2016 standards, (2) AG Algorithm Code — 3 layers (personalization keyword, alphanumeric digits, unix timestamp), (3) MD5 Hash Integrity — 32-char hex integrity verification, (4) QR Verification Sensitivity — 15-check limit per code, (5) Label Release — tamper-evident, code void when the label is opened.

items.q: What is an AG code and how does it work?
items.a: The AG (Authentic Guards) code is a 13-digit security code produced with a 3-layer algorithm: brand personalization keyword, unique alphanumeric digits, and a unix timestamp matrix in milliseconds. Each code is MD5-hashed into a 32-character hex identifier that cannot be reversed, then integrated into a QR code compliant with ISO/IEC 18004:2015.

items.q: How long is the product verification response time?
items.a: The system uses 5 security layers: multi-layer server security, 3-layer AG algorithm, MD5 hash for data integrity, QR verification sensitivity (15x limit), and label release. When the label is opened/removed, the QR code automatically becomes invalid. Every duplication attempt is detected by the system.

items.q: How does the system prevent code duplication and misuse?
items.a: Each AG code has a verification limit of up to 15 times. If the limit is reached without validation, the system automatically suspends the code for investigation. In addition, the tamper-evident label makes the code void when the label is removed — preventing code transfer to counterfeit products.
